item.title: Court overturns 2017 conviction of Sierra LaMar’s suspected killer
item.description: Santa Clara County authorities are considering their next steps after an appeals court overturned the conviction of a man accused of kidnapping and murdering Morgan Hill teen Sierra LaMar in 2012. California’s Sixth Appellate District announced on Feb. 27 that the 2017 conviction of Antolin Garcia Torres on a first degree murder charge is reversed. […]

item.title: Guest View: Groundwater, the hidden resource we rely on every day
item.description: Each year, communities across America take time to recognize an important but unseen part of our water supply: groundwater.
